cohort: The study included 307 women with prior C-sections presenting at PIMS hospital Islamabad.
finding: Placenta previa was observed in 27.7% of patients with a prior caesarean section, and its association was statistically significant with maternal age, parity, and the number of previous caesarean sections.
mod_finding: The number of previous caesarean sections was significantly associated with placenta previa.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from March 1, 2021, to March 1, 2022, on women with prior C-sections during their current pregnancy.
